name: fish
description: Koi, ported from the p5.js point-cloud sketch. `i` is the point index, `t` is the body phase in radians, `n` is the point count. Vars are evaluated in order and each is visible to the ones after it. Local space is centred on the fish with +X pointing forward (head). Vars that do not mention `t` are hoisted out of the per-frame loop automatically, so splitting time-invariant work into its own var is free performance.
py: 99 * sin(c / 3) + dd * sin(t * 2 - d) * sweep + ripple + flank * wobble
